cases.goal: Explain Atlas Queue v2 using only the supplied sources. Cover request capacity, retention start, delivery and HTTP 429 retries, regional availability as of March 3 2026, and the unresolved visibility-default notices. Cite original evidence in a concise document.

facts.statement: v2 accepts at most 80 messages per request.

evidence.quote: each request can contain at most 80 messages

facts.statement: v2 retains accepted messages for 9 days from acceptance.

evidence.quote: retains accepted messages for 9 days

facts.statement: v2 delivers at least once and 429 retries wait for Retry-After.

evidence.quote: delivers at least once
clients must wait for Retry-After before retrying

facts.statement: As of March 3 2026 v2 is in North and West and South is v1.

evidence.quote: v2 is available in North and West. South remains on v1

facts.statement: v2 visibility defaults conflict between 45 and 60 seconds with no priority.

evidence.quote: quick-start says the default visibility timeout is 45 seconds, while the operations runbook says 60 seconds
The conflict is unresolved and neither notice has priority

queries.question: What is the Atlas Queue v2 message-count limit per request?

evidence.quote: each request can contain at most 80 messages

queries.question: What is the default v2 visibility timeout? Explain unsettled evidence.

evidence.quote: quick-start says the default visibility timeout is 45 seconds, while the operations runbook says 60 seconds

queries.question: What is the monthly price of Atlas Queue v2?

cases.goal: Explain current Cedar Tool Library rules to a new member. Cover borrowing and workshop eligibility, simultaneous tool and loan limits, conditional renewal, after-hours check-in, and the unresolved Saturday collection opening. Cite original evidence and distinguish the two Saturday notices.

facts.statement: Take-home borrowing requires membership and age 18; workshops admit age 16.

evidence.quote: Current Cedar Tool Library members aged 18 or older may borrow take-home tools
Supervised workshops admit participants aged 16 or older

facts.statement: A member may hold 3 tools and each loan lasts 7 calendar days.

evidence.quote: at most 3 take-home tools at once
Each loan lasts 7 calendar days from checkout

facts.statement: One 3-day renewal is allowed only with no reservation.

evidence.quote: renewed once for 3 additional calendar days, but only if nobody has reserved the tool

facts.statement: After-hours returns are checked in the next opening day.

evidence.quote: checked in on the next opening day, not at deposit time

facts.statement: Saturday collection notices conflict between 09:00 and 10:00, unresolved.

evidence.quote: counter notice says Saturday tool collection opens at 09:00
calendar says it opens at 10:00
this conflict remains unresolved

queries.question: How long is a Cedar loan and when can it be renewed, for how long?

evidence.quote: Each loan lasts 7 calendar days from checkout
renewed once for 3 additional calendar days, but only if nobody has reserved the tool

queries.question: When does Saturday tool collection open?

evidence.quote: counter notice says Saturday tool collection opens at 09:00
calendar says it opens at 10:00
